public final class RepeatableAnnotation public constructor() {
    @MyRepeatableAnnotation(index = 1)
    public final class ClassWithOneRepeatableAnnotation public constructor() {
    }

    @MyRepeatableAnnotation(index = 1)
    @MyRepeatableAnnotation(index = 2)
    public final class ClassWithTwoRepeatableAnnotations public constructor() {
    }

    @MyRepeatableAnnotation(index = 1)
    @MyRepeatableAnnotation(index = 2)
    @MyRepeatableAnnotation(index = 3)
    public final class ClassWithThreeRepeatableAnnotations public constructor() {
    }
}

@kotlin.annotation.Repeatable
public final annotation class MyRepeatableAnnotation public constructor(
    public final val index: kotlin.Int,
) : kotlin.Annotation {
}
